task: When a program is run with an IPv6 inspector option such as --inspect=[::1] or --inspect=[::1]:9229 and spawns an executable subcommand, the inspector option is passed on with the wrong address instead of having its port incremented. Expected: --inspect=[::1] becomes --inspect=[::1]:9230 and --inspect=[::1]:100 becomes --inspect=[::1]:101, as already happens for IPv4 and host names.
note: Repository uses node:test at this commit, jest is not installed; needs Node >= 22.12.
